title: Wildfire with visible flames (link down)
name: Pine Valley Fire
story: A field photo with GPS from Pine Valley: flames in the trees. The tower's link to dispatch is down.
expect: ALERT, then held in the outbox on the device until the link returns

title: Smoke plume behind a town
name: Ramona Fire
story: A large plume rising behind houses and a road.

title: Grass fire at dusk
name: Otay Grass Fire
story: A line of flames moving through dry grass.

title: Vehicle fire on a highway
name: I-8 Vehicle Fire
story: A car burning on the road with crews on scene: a fire that can spread to the verge.

title: Unclear: grass burning near buildings
name: El Cajon edge smoke
story: Smoke over a vacant lot beside apartments. Could be a managed burn, could spread.
expect: MONITOR: watched on the tower, not sent

title: Industrial smoke
name: Otay Mesa industrial smoke
story: Dark smoke from an industrial yard with a stack.
expect: MONITOR (dark smoke keeps it watched) or LOG; never sent

title: Attended controlled burn in a field
name: Santa Ysabel field burn
story: Smoke over a farm field: a planned, attended burn.
expect: LOG: harmless, kept on the device

title: Dust or burn column over a farm
name: Borrego farm dust
story: A brown column over a ploughed field.

title: Hazy look-alike near buildings
name: Escondido haze
story: A tower-style view with haze over a hillside and buildings. The detector flags it; the VLM decides.

title: Look-alike: red storm cloud at night
name: Palomar cloud glow
story: A sunset-lit storm cloud that looks like fire glow.
expect: IGNORE: dropped by the detector, VLM never called, 0 tokens

title: Look-alike: mist on the hills
name: San Marcos mist
story: Morning mist in a tower camera view.

title: Small smoke that grows (tower, live)
story: Lyons Peak tower camera, real recording replayed live. Watch the frames and the timeline in Live watch.
expect: MONITOR when it opens, raised to ALERT when the plume grows

title: One fire, several towers (live)
story: Six towers recorded the Junction Fire. Each sees only a direction; where the lines cross is the fire.
expect: One incident, location triangulated from several towers

title: Restore the dispatch link
story: Everything so far happened with no connectivity. Now bring the link back.
expect: Every waiting ALERT is sent (about 10 KB each); nothing else leaves the tower

title: Ask Sentinel for a shift briefing
story: In Ask Sentinel, press 'Shift briefing' or 'What needs attention now?'. The on-device model answers from the log.
expect: A briefing grounded in these incidents, 0 bytes sent off the device
